def charbox(L):
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(15,45) for c in range(15,54) if L[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    # exclude blue square region rows>=36 cols<=27
    p=[(r,c) for (r,c) in p if not (r>=36 and c<=27)]
    if not p: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in p];cs=[x[1] for x in p]
